slides.copy: Not every love story needs a big life.
She points at the sky. He looks at her first.

caption:
Some people do not make life louder. They just notice your tiny excitement, stand beside it, and somehow the smallest moments start feeling like home.

Send this to the person who makes your small life feel enough.
copy_notes: Do not use the exact external reference line.
Let the visuals carry most of the tenderness.
